findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?
findings.quote: Servicen er en moderne driftsplatform, som bygger på open source. Applikationer og data i GovCloud er til enhver tid placeret i Statens Its datacentre i Danmark.
findings.quote_english: The service is a modern operating platform built on open source. Applications and data in GovCloud are at all times located in Statens It's data centres in Denmark.

findings.note: Operator's own site, independent of the annual report, states that Statens It runs its own data centres in Denmark; the 2026 mål- og resultatplan (statens-it.dk/media/tyhln1x4) adds that a new data centre is to be commissioned by Q4 2026.

review.reason: The page says GovCloud applications and data sit at all times in Statens It's data centres in Denmark, stated in the present tense, so state-run government data centres are operating today.

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?
findings.quote: GovCloud er under udfasning og erstattes af SIT Cloud Kubernetes Services (KS). Vi tager således ikke nye kunder ind på GovCloud-servicen.
findings.quote_english: GovCloud is being phased out and is replaced by SIT Cloud Kubernetes Services (KS). We therefore do not take new customers onto the GovCloud service.
findings.title: GovCloud fra Statens It
findings.note: Shows the government cloud is live and being succeeded by SIT Cloud Kubernetes Services, Statens It's private cloud; the platform name should be SIT Cloud rather than GovCloud.

review.reason: Statens It's GovCloud is being phased out but still serves existing customers (the page links to their operating status), and it is being replaced by the existing SIT Cloud Kubernetes Services, so a state cloud platform is in operation, not just announced.

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: The MitID partnership consists of the Agency for Digital Government, representing the state, the Danish regions, and municipalities, and the country's financial institutions, represented by their industry organization, Finance Denmark. It is the MitID partnership that is the sole owner of MitID.

review.reason: MitID is owned by a partnership of the state, regions, municipalities and the banks (via Finance Denmark), so it is jointly public and private rather than solely state-controlled; the quote describes ownership, not operation.

findings.question: Does a statute or binding regulation require government data (or classified government data) to be stored and processed under national or EU jurisdiction? yes = A statute or binding regulation requires it for government data generally; partial = Required only for classified data or only for named sectors; no = A source states there is no such requirement
findings.quote: Bekendtgørelse om hel eller delvis opbevaring her i landet af personoplysninger, der behandles i nærmere bestemte it-systemer, og som føres for den offentlige forvaltning
findings.quote_english: Order on full or partial storage in this country of personal data processed in specified IT systems kept for the public administration
findings.title: Lokationskravsbekendtgørelsen
findings.note: Issued under databeskyttelsesloven § 3(9), the order requires only 15 named government IT systems (CPR, MitID, NemLog-in3, FMK, police systems, Statens Lønløsning, 112) to be kept in Denmark, not government data in general.

review.reason: The order's title, and its § 1, require storage in Denmark only for specific named IT systems, not for government data in general.
